claim_boundary: All differences are finite-sample syntactic proof-distribution comparisons at seed 42. They do not establish semantic mathematical-strategy diversity.
hypothesis: Persistent hard exclusion preserves a broader useful correct tail than soft within-batch likelihood reweighting under matched training and evaluation budgets.

registered_decision_rule.claim_boundary: syntactic exploration under one registered seed; not semantic strategy diversity
registered_decision_rule.material_support_rule: at least +5% raw and 16-correct-draw tactic-mode coverage, no more than a five-point correctness loss, and positive direction at all six frozen representations
registered_decision_rule.practical_null_rule: both raw and 16-draw relative mode differences are within +/-5%
